answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 157493 Country: india Title: Will ghusl be waji in this case? Question: I want to ask that if me and my wife are sleeping together with dressed up, and hugging each other tightly, if our private parts touch with each other’s private parts, but we are dressed in, do we need to do ghusl or not? Answer ID: 157493 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 429/328/SN=4/1439) Ghusl will not be wajib in the above mentioned case if semen is not discharged.
